newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico sets grain production goal of 37 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico sets grain production goal of 37 mln tonnes.

text.p: Mexico will seek to produce 37 million tonnes of grain a year by 2000, up from the expected production of 33 million tonnes by the end of this year, the government said on Wednesday.
"Mexico will produce enough food to meet the demands of its people," said a government document presented to President Ernesto Zedillo in a ceremony. "Our productive efforts will have a human face."
An Agriculture Ministry report presented to Zedillo said grain production was 31.2 million tonnes in 1996 and exepected to grow to 33 million tonnes this year.

Mexican Agriculture Minister Francisco Labastida has said in the past that Mexico will need to import five million to six million tonnes of grain in 1997 to meet demand, down from imports of 9.5 million tonnes in 1996.
